$comment: OURS, but transcribed from Cursor's OWN validator rather than from its prose. Cursor publishes no schema for .cursor/hooks.json; cursor.com/schemas/hooks.schema.json serves the docs SPA. It does ship the validator: the bundled hooks package rejects an unknown event name, a missing or fractional version, and a malformed handler before a hook can fire. Read 2026-09-10 out of two artifacts that carry the same code, the cursor-agent CLI package (2026.09.08-6caf4ff, dist-package/index.js, module ../hooks/dist/index.js) and the desktop app (3.19.19, resources/app/extensions/cursor-agent-host/dist/main.js). Digests and URLs are in testdata/hostschemas/SOURCES.md.
title: Cursor hooks.json

version.$comment: Required. Cursor rejects a missing or fractional version, so a config without one loads nowhere.

stop_hook_loop_limit.$comment: Deprecated. Cursor warns and ignores it; loop_limit on a handler replaced it.

hooks.$comment: The 21 events Cursor's own enum names, in its order. Cursor errors on any other key, so this list is a rename detector rather than a preference.

handler.$comment: Open on purpose: Cursor reports no unknown-key error, so a schema that closed the object would be stricter than the host and fail a config Cursor loads.

prompt.$comment: Cursor trims before testing for empty, so a whitespace-only prompt passes here and fails there.

matcher.$comment: A STRING, and outside "" and "*" it must compile as a regex. The field table on cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks types it as an object, which the validator contradicts; the binary is what runs.

timeout.$comment: Seconds. Over 3600 Cursor warns and still runs.
